_doc: Hunters' Outfitter catalogue for Hunters vs Farmers (docs/hvf-PLAN.md §7), sold at any of the hunter's lodges (within lodge.range + 2 m). Same rules as line war's items (stream I): 6 slots, no slot types, every copy counts, `uniqueEquipped` refuses a second copy, `group` = only one item of that group carried (horses), consumables have charges. Effects: speed (fraction), chopMult, sightPct, damage (flat per hit), armorPct (damage taken cut), regen (hp/s), snares (+ standing), and use effects: ward (plant a watchstone: command `ward`), flare, hound (summon a hound pet), torch (x2 damage to buildings for seconds).

horse1.name: Pony
horse1.desc: +15% speed. One mount at a time.

watchstone.desc: Plant up to three watchstones: 12 m of sight for 5 minutes. Farmers can pull them up.

flare.name: Flare
flare.desc: Light up 20 m around a point for 6 s.

hound.name: Hound
hound.desc: A hound that runs to the nearest animal within 20 m and bays.

torch.name: Torch Oil
torch.desc: Double damage to buildings for 60 s.
